name: Sodexo SA

FY2026 results (Aug YE): revenue EUR23,963m, organic +2.0%, UOP -28.9% to EUR810m (margin ~3.4%)

management.senior_turnover_5y: High: CEOs Denis Machuel (to 2021) -> Sophie Bellon (2022-25) -> Delaporte; multiple guidance cuts
management.guidance_record: Poor: FY25 and FY26 guidance revised down (FY26 organic cut to 1.2-1.5%, then beat at 2.0%)

ownership.controlling_holders: Bellon SA (founding family) ~42-43% of capital and ~55-60% of voting rights via double voting (recall, not re-verified)

C.rationale: Scale not converting into competitive economics.

evidence: Outsourcing runway exists; 2030 plan targets >5% organic
Pluxee spin crystallised value; leverage ~3.5x provider incl. leases
Bellon family control via double voting
Meta global contract is food service (not capex)
UOP -29% in FY26 shows operating leverage to volume/mix

sector_specific.mobilisation_costs: Meta global contract ramp FY27 (cost not quantified)

gates.notes: G1: provider ND/EBITDA 3.47x (IFRS, incl. leases) - just below 3.5x; EBITDAaL basis likely lower on pre-lease net debt, but EBITDA fell sharply in FY26 - lead to confirm on standardised basis (could become B). G4: FY25 FCF EUR459m vs NI ~EUR720m (~64%) with exceptional tax outflow - borderline; lead to confirm. G6: Pluxee spin is historic (Feb-2024), no pending transaction.

bull_points: Turnaround optionality: 2030 plan targets >5% organic and >5% margin from a depressed ~3.4% base.
Meta global contract shows ability to win large accounts.
bear_points: Retention 94.4% and organic 2.0% lag peers materially; FY27 guide only +2-3%.
Profit fell 29% in FY26; three CEOs in five years and repeated guidance cuts.
Family control limits activist pressure and strategic optionality.
